claims.claim: Nucor identity/tradability are validated; Q2/guidance are issuer-primary and Sep 25 valuation is independently sourced; duplicate issuer origins are separated by release event.

unknowns.unknown: Project-level returns on new capacity remain incompletely evidenced.

claims.claim: Nucor combines strong Q2 operating momentum, domestic EAF scale and downstream breadth with disciplined long-duration capital returns, while steel-cycle and valuation risks remain material.

thesisQuality.basis: Domestic EAF steelmaking scale, downstream products and durable infrastructure demand support a strong thesis, tempered by cyclicality.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 2026 revenue and core earnings improved sharply year over year and exceeded prior guidance; Helion mark is excluded from core execution.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep 25 price $247.25 and market cap $56.10B after a 79% one-year market-cap increase imply balanced rather than compelling asymmetry.

catalystScore.basis: Healthy steel pricing/demand and capacity investments are credible catalysts, but realization remains cycle- and execution-dependent.

governancePower.basis: Long dividend continuity and separation of non-operating Helion gains from adjusted performance support disciplined, transparent capital stewardship.

alignment2036.basis: Steel remains foundational to infrastructure, energy, manufacturing and construction across plausible 2036 scenarios.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Steel mills, steel products and raw-material capabilities reuse procurement, recycling, production and customer channels across end markets.

bottleneckControl.basis: Large domestic steel capacity and long-lead production assets provide meaningful constraint participation, though steel remains globally substitutable.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Broad end-market exposure and EAF flexibility support resilience, offset by construction/manufacturing cycle and trade-policy sensitivity.

substitutionResilience.basis: Steel is difficult to replace broadly in structural applications and Nucor spans multiple product forms, though imports and alternative materials constrain the score.

supplyChainResilience.basis: EAF/recycled-scrap model and integrated raw-material capabilities provide practical domestic sourcing flexibility.

pricingPower.basis: Current margin expansion and domestic supply conditions support pricing capture, but commodity steel spreads remain cyclical.

riskEvidence.basis: Steel spreads, utilization, construction/manufacturing demand, trade policy and capital-project execution remain material cyclical risks.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Two issuer-primary event sources plus independent current valuation support the record; project-level returns and through-cycle margins remain uncertain.

scoreRecord.thesis: Scaled domestic EAF producer with broad downstream leverage and strong current execution, balanced by steel-cycle and valuation risk.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Steel spreads and utilization can reverse quickly while new-capacity returns disappoint.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Next quarterly results, steel pricing/utilization and project ramp updates.

risks.risk: Steel-cycle reversal and project-return uncertainty can compress earnings.
